description: The host of the Check A Pro Radio Show, Jim Klauck A.K.A. Check A Pro Joe is a crusader for the homeowner. Check A Pro Joe is dedicated to serving his community by providing a FREE Referral Service to his radio listeners nationwide. Check A Pro Joe checks Licenses, Insurance and References on each and every Home Service Provider listed on the website. Tune in every week to learn what to look out for when hiring a contractor for you your home.
